name: popup-flat
summary: OSD popups (No signal, input name, ...) without the empty dark header band: one uniform gray box, message vertically centred

edits.asm: popup_rows: state 0x19 keeps the header row, all other popups skip rows 0/1 (linker padding 0x203C00)
b.ori r7,r0,0x11 (+1st byte of b.sb) -> b.j popup_rows; the rest of the b.sb is never reached
OSD state 4 page 3B8218: message item row 2 -> 1
OSD state 8 page 3B8D74: message item row 2 -> 1
OSD state 9 page 3B8DB8: message item row 2 -> 1

notes: sub_256C92 paints rows 0/1 of every small popup with the menu header band (attribute 0x11 and the half-tile glyph 2) although only state 0x19 places text there. The patch leaves those rows at the window fill (attribute 0xFF, gray) for all popups except state 0x19, and moves the one-line message of states 2/4 (25x3) and 8/9/0x0C (20x4 -> 20x3) to the middle row.
